title: Reorder
description: What to order, from each item's real usage. Reorder point = daily usage × (lead time + safety days); order up to par = daily usage × (lead time + order cycle + safety days).

levels.hint: Saves reorder point as low stock and par as ideal stock: low-stock alerts and purchase orders use them.
levels.mainOnly: Only the main branch can change stock levels (shared by all branches).

empty.title: Nothing to order
empty.description: Every item with usage has enough stock for the lead time and safety days.
